notes.title: HUGE QUICK RACE UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello Quick Racers!

We have good newsfor you! We decided to rebuild the driving model and that change the gameplay completely! From now on, you will have no problems get the car out after you hit the wall! Also after wall hit will be not rotated by 180 degrees!

Changes:

[olist]
The driving model has been improved, the vehicle control has been made easier and the driving model is now more real.
Now that we are in the game, the mouse disappears.
Physics has been improved.
Now cars differ in specifications.
The game loading system has been improved.
[/olist]


Bugfix:
[olist]
     Fixed a bug that did not correctly show the position of the 2nd player in the match.
[/olist]




Thank you so much for you support!
Love you xoxoxox
Source Byte Sp. z o.o.
